_comment: Windows x64 PostgreSQL 16 binaries bundled into the installer (extraResources: build/pgsql -> resources/pgsql). Run `npm run fetch:pg` before electron-builder. sha256 is the hash of the downloaded zip and MUST be pinned by whoever releases (copy it from the vendor page and check it independently); fetch refuses to run while it is null. url and version are NOT verified from this repository.
license: PostgreSQL License (permissive); the EDB zip also carries third-party libraries (OpenSSL, ICU, libxml2, zlib ...)
